protocol: Per side: posterior +Y, superior +Z, lateral (right -X; left +X). Fixed 2x1 neck, 4x3x5 dome, 0.5 blend mm. No stop after success.

frame_proposal.limitation: Centerline-radius envelope, not atlas mesh. First sampled ray exit; unsampled exits may exist. Finite differences do not prove differentiability. Dimensions retained; all geometry checks required.

neck.curve_convention: 64 ellipse samples; last connects to first

specification.graph_policy: Preserve every incident edge and outlet; sac is a lesion, not a daughter artery

rim_inspection.scope: All straight chords including last-to-first; capsule scalar-field residual bound
rim_inspection.limitation: Not exact Euclidean distance to a tapered union surface, smoothness, ray completeness, atlas mesh attachment, or a generated lumen. Floating-point arithmetic is not interval certified.

self_contact.limitations: Finite-precision tests, not exact predicates. Other vessels not checked. Adjacent pairs check overlap beyond shared topology, not clearance.

metadata.limitation: Open dome disk only; no parent surface trimming or lumen union. Boundary positions are preserved, not parent tangent continuity. No surrounding clearance check.

inspection.scope: Surface intersections only; fully contained disjoint surfaces can overlap in volume.
